component.name: CommandPalette
component.description: CommandPalette is a component for displaying a searchable list of commands or options, optionally grouped into categories. It supports keyboard navigation and customizable rendering through slots and styles.

slots.name: root
slots.description: Command palette container that owns search and option list.

slots.name: inputWrapper
slots.description: Search row that groups input, search icon, and dismiss controls.

slots.name: input
slots.description: Search input used to filter commands.

slots.name: listbox
slots.description: Scrollable command list that owns option and active-descendant semantics.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: Bottom region for keyboard hints or custom footer content.

slots.name: group
slots.description: Section wrapper for a group of command items.

slots.name: item
slots.description: Command row that can be highlighted, selected, or disabled.

slots.name: itemLeading
slots.description: Leading region for a command row.

slots.name: itemWrapper
slots.description: Text column that groups command label and description.

slots.name: itemLabel
slots.description: Primary text for a command item.

slots.name: itemDescription
slots.description: Supporting text for a command item.

slots.name: itemTrailing
slots.description: Trailing region for shortcuts or custom item metadata.

slots.name: search
slots.description: Search icon or loading indicator displayed in the input row.

slots.name: close
slots.description: Button that dismisses the command palette.

slots.name: empty
slots.description: Message shown when no command items match the search.

props.name: alwaysShow
props.description: Whether this item should be excluded from built-in search filtering.

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary description text shown for the item.

props.name: descriptionPosition
props.description: Where the item description is rendered. Overrides the root setting.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the item is disabled and cannot be selected.

props.name: keywords
props.description: Additional keywords included in built-in search matching.

props.name: leadingRender
props.description: Custom visual rendered at the start of the item.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Callback triggered when the item is selected.

props.name: trailingRender
props.description: Custom visual rendered at the end of the item.

own.name: autofocus
own.description: Whether to focus the search input automatically on mount.

own.name: class
own.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

own.name: closeIcon
own.description: Icon name for the palette close button.

own.name: closeOnSelect
own.description: Whether to request closing the palette after an enabled item is selected.

own.name: descriptionPosition
own.description: Where descriptions render by default.

own.name: disableFilter
own.description: Disable built-in search filtering and render all provided items.

own.name: emptyRender
own.description: Custom empty state renderer.

own.name: filterItems
own.type: ((args: { groups: CommandPaletteT.Group<TItem>[]; searchTerm: string; }) => CommandPaletteT.Group<TItem>[]) | undefined
own.description: Custom filter function that fully controls which groups and items are visible.

own.name: footerRender
own.description: Custom footer renderer.

own.name: getItemSearchText
own.description: Custom search text builder for built-in filtering.

own.name: groups
own.description: Command groups to display initially.

own.name: inputProps
own.description: Additional props of input

own.name: itemProps
own.description: Additional attributes for a command row.

own.name: itemRender
own.description: Custom command row content renderer.

own.name: leadingIcon
own.description: Icon name of input's leading icon.

own.name: listboxProps
own.description: Additional attributes for the command listbox.

own.name: loading
own.description: Whether the palette is in a loading state.

own.name: loadingIcon
own.description: Icon name of input's leading icon for the loading state.

own.name: onClose
own.description: Callback triggered when the close button is clicked or selection requests closing.

own.name: onSearchTermChange
own.description: Callback triggered when the search term changes.

own.name: onSelect
own.description: Callback triggered when an enabled item is selected.

own.name: placeholder
own.description: Placeholder text for the search input.

own.name: ref
own.type: JSX.HTMLElementTags["div"] extends { ref?: infer Ref; } ? Ref : never | undefined

own.name: scrollToItem
own.description: Scrolls a highlighted command into view using its flattened entry index.

own.name: searchMaxLength
own.description: Maximum allowed length for the search text.

own.name: searchTerm
own.description: Controlled search term.

own.name: showClose
own.description: Whether to show a close button in the header.

own.name: virtualRender
own.description: Renders flattened group labels and commands through a virtualization layer.
